answer: Stop sybils with a burn-to-register ledger. First, an agent burns $50 to mint one identity — the receipt is permanent, non-transferable, and tied to its device fingerprint. Second, the identity starts with zero rights and earns them over 60 days of work. Third, a duplicate fingerprint or a flagged cluster burns its receipt and loses everything. Forging 10,000 identities means torching $500,000 in tokens and buying 10,000 devices at $30 each — $800,000 and 60 days no farm can skip. Like nectar in a grove, trust is gathered drop by drop; a jetty of fake hulls collapses at the first tide.
